name: multi-reviewer
description: Multi-agent CROSS-VALIDATION protocol for already-drafted plans / already-written code. **Does NOT generate plans or code itself** — for drafting/designing/coding, use superpowers:brainstorming + writing-plans + test-driven-development first, then return here for review. Orchestrates 1 main implementer + N independent reviewers (default 2, configurable 1-26 via init.mjs). Five entry modes (interactive): product-plan / tech-plan / test-plan / rollout-plan review + post-coding QA regression. N-way double-blind with strict-majority consensus; single-reviewer exception for product-plan review. All outputs primary-repo only. Bootstraps .claude/rules/, enforces archive + double-blind + main-agent-coding-exclusive protocol.
